source: Official voter files: early and mail voters matched to the primary voter history

2026.span: the 2024 and 2026 primaries and runoffs, including March 2024's presidential primary

note: Georgia has no party registration. Party here is the last party primary each voter took part in (the 2024 and 2026 primaries and runoffs, including March 2024's presidential primary), matched voter by voter from the Secretary of State's Voter History Files and Voter Absentee File. Primaries are open, so a primary ballot isn't a party registration, and None means no party primary in that span, including new voters. The files are downloaded by hand, so this updates only when a new file is added.
